dwelling_habits.dwelling: Drier edges of mangrove forests and coastal thickets.
dwelling_habits.feeding: Makes energy from sunlight (and sometimes from clear shallow water light).
dwelling_habits.mating: Spreads by spores, seeds, propagules, or creeping rhizomes depending on the species.
dwelling_habits.socializing: Forms habitat structure that shelters fish, crabs, and invertebrates.

fun_facts: Not always feet-in-water, but still part of the mangrove crew.
Silver-leaf varieties shimmer in coastal wind.
